caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probabilities of clinically relevant tokens for the MistralV0.2-Base model and variants fine-tuned on six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by specialty group, labeled in order from left to right as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, with each group containing seven vertical bars representing the baseline model and the six fine-tuned variants. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” ranges from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals, indicating a linear scale. The baseline MistralV0.2-Base model is represented by a light blue bar in each group and consistently exhibits the highest negative log probability (i.e., lowest likelihood) across all specialties, with values ranging from approximately -26.8 in Cardio to -23.5 in Infect. The fine-tuned models are color-coded: light orange for Cardio, medium orange for Gastro, dark orange for Infect, brown for Neuro, dark brown for Obstetrics, and black for Pediatrics. Within each specialty group, the fine-tuned variant corresponding to that specialty typically shows the lowest negative log probability (i.e., strongest prediction), though the Gastro-tuned model frequently achieves the lowest values across multiple specialties. The Infect group displays the highest overall bar heights, with the baseline at approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group shows the smallest difference between baseline and fine-tuned variants, approximately 1.5 units. Bars are grouped by specialty and are not sorted by value; no bars are visually emphasized beyond color coding.
